task: Generate page-level MSP-1 from URL only
input: Generate MSP-1 for: https://example.com/page (no HTML provided).
output: Cannot infer page `name`, `description`, `intent`, or `interpretiveFrame` from a URL alone. Either permit a minimal identity-only v1.0.1 declaration using the supplied URL as `page.id`/`page.url`, or provide pasted HTML, document metadata, or content excerpts for richer MSP-1 metadata.

task: Generate site-level MSP-1 with missing site identity
input: Create site-level MSP-1 but I won't provide the site name or canonical root URL.
output: Cannot generate site-level MSP-1 without stable site identity (`site.name`, `site.url`, and stable `site.id`). Provide the canonical site root URL and site name.

input: {"@context":"https://msp-1.org/schema/msp-1-page.json","protocol":{"name":"MSP-1","version":"1.0.1"},"page":{"id":"https://x.test/p","url":"https://x.test/p"}}
output: Valid MSP-1 v1.0.1 page identity: `page.id` and `page.url` are present. Advisory: add `page.name`, `description`, `intent`, and `interpretiveFrame` when observable; `page.title` is retained only as a compatibility field.

input: {"@context":"https://msp-1.org/schema/msp-1-page.json","protocol":{"name":"MSP-1","version":"1.0.1"},"page":{"id":"https://x.test/p","url":"https://x.test/p","name":"T"},"aiRankBoost":{"value":9000}}
output: Advisory: non-schema field detected. Unknown fields are not active MSP-1 v1.0.1 terms and should not be emitted by protocol tools unless they are part of a separately defined extension. Remove or isolate the field before publishing clean MSP-1 metadata.

input: {"@context":"https://msp-1.org/schema/msp-1-site.json","protocol":{"name":"MSP-1","version":"1.0.1"},"discovery":{"wellKnown":"/msp.json","canonical":true},"site":{"id":"https://x.test/#site","name":"X","url":"https://x.test"}}
output: Invalid discovery: canonical MSP-1 discovery endpoint is `/.well-known/msp.json`. Update `discovery.wellKnown` accordingly.

task: Review page-level MSP-1 for scope leakage (authority)
input: A page-level block declares authority.scope = 'site' and authority.role='publisher of record' for a single blog post.
output: Scope leakage: page-level metadata should not assert site-wide authority or trust context. Move site-wide declarations to `/.well-known/msp.json` and keep page-level authority/trust scoped to the page unless independently supported.

input: An MSP-1 block states: canonical.url is set, therefore trust.verificationLevel='verified'.
output: Canonical identifies the preferred URL representation and does not imply verification. Keep `canonical` separate from `trust`; use `trust.level` only as low, medium, or high, and use `verificationLevel` only when a verification process is actually declared.

task: Emit interpretiveFrame for an opinion piece
input: HTML indicates an editorial/opinion column with subjective language and first-person perspective.

interpretiveFrame.frame: Content expresses opinion and interpretation; claims should be evaluated as perspective, not neutral fact.

input: Draft `description.short` for a product page but the author includes: 'the best product ever made'.
output: Description should be concise and factual. Move persuasive language out of MSP-1; keep `description.short` scope-true and non-promotional.

input: A tool updates `intent.statement` but leaves revision unchanged.
output: Non-ideal lifecycle handling: metadata changed without a corresponding `revision` update. Treat managed metadata edits as revision events and update `revisionDate`, `revisionNotes`, and `revisionVersion` when revision metadata is used.

input: Page MSP-1 sets trust.level='high' and trust.verificationLevel='verified' but provenance.type='original' and no reviewer or verification context is present.
output: Trust context appears overstated. High trust or verified status should be supported by reviewer, authority, provenance, or verification context. Without support, use a lower `trust.level` or omit trust metadata.
